text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan studies the field of 
competitors in preparation for this
year's 
Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However,
the girl featured in the magazine 
was, of course,
an Umamusume attending the 
same academy. She had even seen her 
practice before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even without looking at this, on the day 
of the race—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—They were different. All of them were 
different. From their aura to everything 
else, they were on another level.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the Umamusume's sheer aura up
close in the paddock sends tremors through
Tosen 
Jordan's legs. The Arima Kinen, contested 
by monsters defining the pinnacle of 
strength, begins.
